 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ANJANI KUMAR SHARAN
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the informant and learned counsel for Shriram Transport Finance Company Ltd.
The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under Sections 467, 420 of the Indian Penal Code.

As per FIR, the informant sold a truck to the petitioner on the condition of payment of arrear of installment of Rs. 10,51,000/- from the year 2016 to the year 2018 and the current price of vehicle i.e. Rs. 15,50,000/-.
It is alleged that the petitioner neither paid the installment nor paid the price of vehicle to the informant.

It is also alleged that the petitioner issued two cheques of Rs. 2,00,000/-
and Rs. 2,29,000/- but the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.44624 of 2022(3) dt.19-06-2023 said cheques were dishonoured on account of insufficiency of fund.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
He submits that the petitioner has already paid the said amount to the finance company.
This fact has not been disputed by the learned counsel for the finance company.

He submits that the dispute at best is purely of civil nature He further submits that petitioner has Amarnath Singh @ Amar Nath Singh vs The State Of Bihar on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75141041/
1 criminal antecedent as stated in para-3 of this application.

sentences.text: Learned APP for the Informant opposes the prayer for bail and submits that the petitioner has cheated the informant.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that this case is purely a civil dispute, let the above named petitioner in the event of his arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of six weeks from today, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned court below where the case is pending/successor court in connection with Jagdishpur P.S. Case No. 222 of 2020, subject to the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.44624 of 2022(3) dt.19-06-2023 condition as laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Cr.P.C.
(Anjani Kumar Sharan, J) devendra/-
